transcript.content: Hello, it's nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. I'm here because of... well, what's going on at work. The routing system at the warehouse, it's not just a computer program to me anymore. I know it's been marking my moves. It sends these messages right through the scanners we use, trying to push me out because I'm one of the old hands. I just... I know exactly what it's doing.
How long have you believed that the warehouse routing system is sending you messages to push you out?
Well, it's been going on for a while now. The voices... and, well, this whole thing with knowing what the scanners are up to, it's been with me for about a year and eight months.
How have these experiences affected your ability to do your job and manage your usual daily activities?

Well, it's pretty much stopped me from working. There was... an incident with the forklift a little while back. After that happened, they took me off operating duties entirely. They told me I wasn't safe around the equipment anymore, so they put me on leave. 

And at home... it's not much better. My wife has had to step in and take over just about everything. She handles paying the bills, keeps track of appointments, does most of the chores around the house. I just... I can't keep up with any of it reliably right now.
Were you using any drugs or experiencing withdrawal from them when these experiences first began?
No, I haven't been using any drugs. I don't take anything like that, and I haven't gone through any kind of withdrawal. It's just... this is just what's been happening.
Do you hear voices when you are away from the warehouse and not near the scanners?

Yeah, I do. It doesn't stop when I leave work. Even when I'm at home... just sitting out in my garage with everything completely shut off, I still hear them. I hear the dispatch voices clear as day. They call out my operator number, and they tell me I'm dangerous, or... or they say that security is coming for me.
